purpose: A cheap candidate-only language-preservation gate for post-ZERO.4 experiments. It is an engineering non-inferiority guard, not a general LLM benchmark claim.

decision_rule.rationale: These are prospective engineering preservation tolerances for candidates after ZERO.4: one absolute BLiMP accuracy point and one relative percent TinyStories bits/byte. They are not confidence intervals, equivalence bounds, or a retrofit to make ZERO.4 pass.

output_policy.paired_inference_policy: The historical ZERO.3 result retained aggregate hashes but not case-level correctness or score traces. The first candidate is therefore judged only by the frozen aggregate thresholds. New candidate traces are retained so later predeclared comparisons can use paired analysis; they do not retroactively create a paired ZERO.3 baseline.

execution.observed_basis: ZERO.4 task times from the completed ZERO-EVAL-1 screen

permitted: decide whether a frozen candidate preserves the two declared language-screen metrics within the preregistered tolerances
report candidate minus frozen ZERO.3 on the same 1,000 cases
retain non-copyright per-case traces for future predeclared paired analyses
forbidden: claiming equivalence when the gate passes
tuning a candidate or threshold after viewing gate output
treating a failed gate as evidence about the candidate's trained faculty
launching from this contract without a separate immutable budget and explicit authorization
